me

Not all those who wander are lost. But if you are, I can redirect you to something interesting if you click here.

I’m an engineer trained in applied physics currently @ Center for Molecular Modeling - Ghent University. My field is computational spectroscopy - specifically in solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance. You could check out something on zeolites, something else on covalent organic frameworks, an application of the former to a real-world example or go here. I also teach exercise classes in the first and second years of the engineering study program of my faculty: Molecular Structure, Physics II and Basic Mathematics.

I obtained my PhD from Ghent University in 2026 under the supervision of prof. dr. ir. Veronique Van Speybroeck and dr. ir. Eric Breynaert. The thesis is freely available here.

I like guitarists, technology, cooking, birds, and any show starring Gordon Ramsay. Reach me about anything by dropping a message at siebe(at)siebev(dot)com.
